caveats: The presence rate is the measured precision of frame F1 at this stage. F1 is recall-oriented by construction (amendment 3) and is not retuned in response to this number.
Rates are not comparable across strata without care: the small strata are censused and the large one sampled (amendment 4).
Capture tallies are capped CDX record counts, not unique page counts; only presence (n > 0) is used analytically.
Service failures are not recorded, so absence in the file means not-yet-probed, never a silent failure.
